definitions.explanation: A device used to carry out a particular function, especially in manual work.

examples.japanese: {工具|こうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧{工具|こうぐ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦だから→だから：00924_dakara⟧⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Be careful because power tools are dangerous.

notes:
{工具|こうぐ} refers to tools used for manual work, construction, or repair.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {工具|こうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use tools
- {工具|こうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧: to prepare tools
- ⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧{工具|こうぐ}: power tools

COMPOUNDS:
- {工具|こうぐ}⟦{箱|ばこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧: toolbox
- {工具|こうぐ}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧: tool set
- ⟦{大工|だいく}→大工：04051_daiku⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧: carpentry tools

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧: tool, instrument (broader meaning, includes household items)
- ⟦{器具|きぐ}→器具：03980_kigu⟧: utensil, apparatus (often for specific purposes)
- ⟦{用具|ようぐ}→用具：09667_yougu⟧: equipment, supplies

USAGE:
{工具|こうぐ} specifically implies tools for construction, repair, or technical work, while ⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧ is more general.
